provenance.caveat: Indicative administrative boundaries, not a cadastral survey or a determination of legal boundaries. HDX metadata reports source boundaries created 2018-02-09; retain per-feature valid_on and version fields.
provenance.processing: Selected only the three named barangays under Pili, Camarines Sur. Original GeoJSON feature IDs, properties, coordinate values, ring order and geometry types retained; no simplification, rounding, buffering or invented fallback.
